findings.title: Waterings bed filter is lost on reload/shared link: page reads ?bed= but writes ?bed_id=
findings.steps: Open /waterings, pick a bed in the Bed filter (URL becomes ?bed_id=2). Reload the page or share the URL.
findings.expected: The filter stays on the chosen bed after reload, the same as the 'Watering history' link from the beds page (?bed=2).
findings.actual: waterings.vue starts bedFilter from route.query.bed but the watcher writes { bed_id }. After a reload the filter is ignored and all beds are listed. Links from the beds page use ?bed=, so the two URL forms do not match.
findings.evidence: waterings.vue: `ref(typeof route.query.bed === 'string' ? route.query.bed : '')` vs `router.replace({ query: bedId ? { bed_id: bedId } : {} })`

findings.title: POST /api/waterings returns 500 for NaN or Infinity litres
findings.evidence: curl: 'Internal Server Error [500]' for both payloads

findings.title: Huge integer ids cause 500 on watering endpoints
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error, because SQLite overflows on an integer larger than 64 bits. A user who edits the ?bed= URL on the waterings page sees a generic error.
findings.evidence: curl: all three returned 'Internal Server Error [500]'

findings.title: No request timeout: 'Water now', 'Save watering' and the lists can spin forever
findings.steps: Make the API hang (accept the connection but never answer), then click 'Water now' or open /waterings.
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 seconds, the page shows an error and the button is enabled again.
findings.actual: useApiClient/useApiFetch set no timeout, so the button stays at 'Watering…'/'Saving…' (disabled) and the loading text stays up for as long as the connection hangs.
findings.evidence: composables/useApi.ts: $fetch.create and useFetch are called without a timeout option, and the new watering calls add none.

findings.title: Recording a watering is not idempotent: a retry after a timeout or failed refresh creates duplicates
findings.steps: Click 'Water now'. The POST succeeds but the follow-up refresh() of beds fails (or the response is lost). The page says 'Could not record the watering.' and the user clicks again.
findings.actual: recordWatering wraps both the POST and refresh() in one try. A refresh error is reported as a failed save, and the user's retry inserts a second row. There is no idempotency key or duplicate check on the server.
findings.evidence: beds.vue recordWatering: `await api('/waterings', ...); await refresh()` in the same try/catch. The server inserts on every POST.

findings.title: Shared 'wateringBedId' flag lets concurrent waterings re-enable buttons early
findings.steps: Click 'Water now' on bed A, then quickly on bed B while A is still pending.
findings.expected: Each bed's button stays disabled until its own request finishes, and each bed shows its own result.
findings.actual: There is a single wateringBedId, waterError and waterNotice. Starting B clears A's busy state, so A can be clicked again (duplicate) and A's result or error message is overwritten or lost.
findings.evidence: beds.vue: one wateringBedId ref, set to null in finally of whichever request finishes first

findings.title: Dashboard 'Recent waterings' error has no retry
findings.steps: Open the dashboard while GET /api/waterings fails.
findings.expected: An error with a Retry button that refetches without a reload
findings.actual: Only an AlertMessage is shown. refresh is not even destructured for wateringsResult, so the user has to reload.
findings.evidence: index.vue: `const { data: waterings, error: wateringsError } = wateringsResult`, and the alert has no button

findings.title: Waterings page: error has no retry, and a failed beds load silently empties the filter
findings.steps: Open /waterings while the API fails, or while /api/beds fails.
findings.expected: An error state with Retry. If the beds fail, the filter says it could not load the beds.
findings.actual: The waterings error shows a message with no retry button. The beds error is never read, so the Bed dropdown just shows 'All beds' with no explanation.
findings.evidence: waterings.vue: `const { data: beds } = bedsResult` (the error is ignored), and AlertMessage has no retry action

findings.title: Tiny litre amounts are accepted and displayed as '0 L'
findings.expected: Rejected with a minimum (the form's min is 0.1), or shown accurately
findings.actual: Stored and returned (201). formatLitres rounds it to 2 decimals and shows '0 L'.
findings.evidence: curl returned 201 with litres 1e-300; formatLitres uses maximumFractionDigits: 2

findings.title: Future-date check uses the server's date, not the user's
findings.steps: A user in a time zone ahead of the server records a past watering for their 'today' (the form defaults to todayIso() in the browser) shortly after their midnight.
findings.actual: The server compares against date.today() in its own zone and returns 'Watering date cannot be in the future.' 'Water now' also stamps watered_on with the server's local date, which can differ from the user's.
findings.evidence: schemas.py not_in_future uses date.today(). waterings.py uses now.astimezone().date().
